name: Mystic
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Mystic?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no. In Mystic, an LSV may use a road whose speed limit is 25 mph or less, unless the town prohibits that road. No Stonington or Groton permit for plain golf carts was found.

golf_cart.notes: A town permit is required and none was found

lsv.roads: Roads with a speed limit of 25 mph or less
lsv.notes: Registered. The town or the state can still close a road.

rules.rule: An LSV may use a highway with an established speed limit of 25 mph or less, unless the traffic authority or the state prohibits that highway.
A traffic authority may permit golf carts in daylight on roads posted 25 mph or less. No Stonington or Groton permit was found.

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Mystic?
faq.a: Roads with a speed limit of 25 mph or less. Registered. The town or the state can still close a road. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Mystic?
faq.a: No. Connecticut requires the town traffic authority to permit it, and no Stonington or Groton permit was found.

faq.q: What is the LSV speed cap in Mystic?
faq.a: 25 mph. A road posted faster than that is closed to LSVs.
